title: fix(service-messaging): resolve a notification template in the recipient's organization
body:
Fixes #24865

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `NotificationTemplateStore.load` (exported from `@objectstack/service-messaging`'s `.` entry) gains the optional `organizationId` parameter. Corrected from `no` by the `domain:services` seat at patch round 2.

## What this changes

`sys_notification_template` is organization-owned (ADR-0131: organization ownership is total; the table carries `organization_id` and the platform-object tenancy census lists it). The messaging template store now resolves the row in the recipient's organization:

- `NotificationTemplateStore.load(topic, channel, locale, organizationId)` (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/template-renderer.ts`) keys its read `where: { organization_id }` under `FAN_OUT_SYSTEM_CONTEXT`, the spelling `PreferenceResolver.loadRows` already scopes its rows by. No new read primitive.
- The email and SMS channels (`email-channel.ts`, `sms-channel.ts`) hand the store the delivery's own organization, `Notification.organizationId`. The inline fan-out and the outbox dispatcher both carry it there from the event row.
- A call that names no organization reads no row and answers `null`, so the channel renders the producer's own title and body (the renderer's documented no-template fallback). Reasoning: there is no row with no organization (ADR-0131 D1), so there is no row such a delivery could own. Measured on the same two-organization harness, the composed fan-out never hands a channel such a delivery: an emit that names no organization is refused (`ERR_SYSTEM_WRITE_ORGANIZATION_REQUIRED`) under `isolated` and `group`, and under `single` with one organization the event row carries that organization (ADR-0131 D9). So this branch changes nothing a composed deployment renders. It closes the shape for direct callers of the exported store.

## The `plugin-auth` reader (patch round 1)

`AuthManager.renderPhoneSmsBody` (the only change in `auth-manager.ts`) hands `phone-sms-texts.ts` the organization a deployment-level act resolves to, `tenancy.defaultOrgId()` (ADR-0093 D3). Every template read there (the active-row read and the existence read) is keyed `where: { organization_id }`.
- Under `single`, the Default Organization's row decides the text.
- Under `isolated` and `group`, no organization resolves, no row is read, and the built-in text is sent. The per-organization template door stays closed under a wall (ADR-0131 §1.4, D6).
- No tenancy service, or a failed resolution, counts as no organization: the built-in text, never a blocked send.

This follows the seat ruling `6295270052`. Its premise was measured on the real tenancy service, under `single`, `isolated` and `group`, enforced and degraded.

- **Pins:** `phone-sms-texts.test.ts`, and `phone-sms-template-organization.integration.test.ts` (the real `AuthManager` invitation and OTP sends, the real tenancy service, two organizations).
- **Ablation:** E 3 red, F 1 red, G 3 red, H 1 red, each restored with blob == `HEAD`.
- **Changeset:** `.changeset/24865-auth-sms-template-organization.md` (`@objectstack/plugin-auth` patch).
- **Fixture triage:** forced by the scoped read, in `phone-sms-seed-retired.test.ts` (including the `Row[]` type fix CI caught), `find-envelope-limb-removal.test.ts` and `auth-manager.test.ts`.

## Reachability, as an abstract statement

Measured at `a7199ef97` on a real `ObjectQL` over `SqlDriver` (better-sqlite3) holding two organizations, under the `isolated` and the `group` posture: before this change, an email or SMS notification delivery to one organization's recipient could render a template row another organization authored, and so could the phone OTP and invitation SMS. `single` enforces no organization wall.

## Pins

- `template-renderer.test.ts`, block "a template is resolved in the recipient's organization": every locale rung of the read is keyed by the organization handed in; a call that names no organization reads nothing.
- `template-organization.integration.test.ts`, on a real engine with two organizations under `isolated` and `group`: each organization's delivery renders its own organization's row, on email and on SMS; an organization that authored no row renders the producer's own title and body; a delivery that names no organization renders the same. Preservation control under `single`: the sole organization's row still renders. Each case first asserts the organization every fixture row is stored with, so no pin passes on a mis-stamped row.
- Existing fixtures (`email-channel.test.ts`, `sms-channel.test.ts`, `system-context.pin.test.ts`): the deliveries that render a template row now name their organization, as every composed delivery does, and the fakes match `organization_id`.

## Ablation (one-off; the fix was committed first, each leg via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored with blob == `HEAD` and `git diff HEAD` empty)

| leg | mutation in `src/` | reading |
|:---|:---|:---|
| A | the `organization_id` term removed from the read | red, 7: the four integration pins "each organization's delivery renders its own organization's row" and "an organization that authored no row renders the producer's own title and body" (`isolated` + `group`), and three store unit pins |
| B | the no-organization guard removed, nothing else | red, 1: the unit read-shape pin. The real-engine pin stayed green: on this engine an `organization_id` term whose value is `undefined` matched no row (it was not dropped as an absent term). Fewer reds than expected, reported as observed; leg C is the forbidden behaviour spelled the way the package spells it |
| C | the guard replaced by the sibling resolver's absent-organization branch (no organization, no term) | red, 3: the integration pin "a delivery that names no organization renders the producer's own title and body" (`isolated` + `group`) and the unit pin |
| D | the organization hand-off dropped from `email-channel.ts`, then from `sms-channel.ts` | red, 3 each: "each organization's delivery renders its own organization's row" (`isolated` + `group`) and the `single` preservation pin |

Subject resolution: the pins import `template-renderer.ts`, `email-channel.ts` and `sms-channel.ts` relatively from `src/`, so no `dist/` sits between a mutation and the run.

- `service-messaging`: typecheck exit 0; vitest 53 files, 593 passed.

Round 0, below, is kept for the record.

### Round 0 (at `bb37f9c62`, the fix merged with `origin/main` at `19484af53`)

- Dependency closure rebuilt after the merge: `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/service-messaging^...`, 15 tasks successful.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging typecheck`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` includes `template-organization.integration.test.ts` and `template-renderer.test.ts`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-messaging exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 53 files, 593 tests passed. The same numbers were read at `8ed3c0638` before the merge.
- Round 0 touched only `@objectstack/service-messaging`. The public surface of `NotificationTemplateStore.load` gains an optional fourth parameter, declared above as `Clause-②: yes`. Its one in-repo consumer is this package (`messaging-service-plugin.ts` and the two channels), so no importer owes a test.

## Gates

Local subset at `bb37f9c62`: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derives 69 commands. Each was run with its exit code captured before any pipe: **69 x exit 0**. Reconciliation `dispatch-gates --ran`: `69 derived, 69 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN`.

An earlier round at `8ed3c0638` had two `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (exit 3) results, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n`, because their build prerequisites were missing. Both measured green in the round above (`check-i18n-bundles: OK (10 package(s) ...)`; service-messaging bundles in sync).

The branch was current with `origin/main` at `19484af53` when this PR opened. Two later commits on `main` touch neither `service-messaging` nor the engine, driver or spec its pins run on.

## Acceptance notes

- **Changeset:** `.changeset/24865-template-recipient-organization.md`, `@objectstack/service-messaging` patch. It states the fourth argument and the no-organization answer for direct callers of the exported store.
- **Observed, not filed (dormant):** `MessagingService.emit` hands the preference filter and the recipient resolver `input.organizationId` (what the producer passed), not the event row's organization the delivery family follows. The two differ only when the producer names none, and under a wall that emit is refused, so no walled delivery reaches them unscoped. Carrier: none.
- `content/docs/kernel/runtime-services/sms-service.mdx` describes the SMS channel rendering the `(topic, 'sms', locale)` row without naming the organization. It is not wrong, so it is left unchanged.
